description: Expected results for the official ADCIRC test-suite case adcirc/adcirc_quarterannular-2d (adcirc-testsuite commit 72bb573): quarter-annulus grid (63 nodes, 96 elements), 5-day tidal run. The expected values are computed from the OFFICIAL control/ solution files of the ADCIRC test suite (Git LFS objects), and the tolerance is the suite's own (1e-5, RunSingleTest.sh err=0.00001).

numeric_checks.name: maxele_max
numeric_checks.why: peak water level over the run, max over nodes (maxele.63 record 1)

numeric_checks.name: maxele_mean
numeric_checks.why: peak water level over the run, mean over nodes

reference: official control/ files; a clean run of the server binary matched them: max |diff| fort.61 1.3e-8, fort.62 7.6e-9, fort.63 1e-14, fort.64 1e-12, maxele.63 0 (byte-identical). fort.54 and maxvel.63 differ only in the phase / time-of-max of near-zero (1e-16..1e-17) values, which carry no meaning.
